Taylor Swift Calls Out Fan for Filming Her During Travis Kelce's Chiefs Game: 'Leave Her Alone'

Taylor Swift called out a fan for filming her while she watched her husband, Travis Kelce, and the Kansas City Chiefs take on the Los Angeles Chargers on Sunday. In a video filmed by another football fan, the pop star was focused on the game from her VIP suite at Arrowhead Stadium when a woman peered inside and pointed her phone directly at Swift, despite being told off by security. Swift, 36, quickly noticed and gestured for the woman to stop recording and watch the game, prompting her to scramble back to her seat. Fans in the comments defended Swift, with one writing, "I do not understand how people think this is OK even after she told you to stop," and another adding, "Leave her alone. Geezzz people." Swift attended the game with Caitlin Clark and Este Haim, wearing a red outfit, after attending the 2026 Academy Museum Gala in Los Angeles the night before, where she wore a Dior pale blue dress and later performed in a dark blue Ralph Lauren design.

TAYLOR SWIFT CELEBRITY POSING HACK 📸 Do you feel awkward posing for photos?

It’s really easy to end up holding a pose for a long time and looking stiff, especially because a lot of us hold tension in our face and our shoulders.

Think about all of the times you’ve been stuck taking a bunch of photos and they just get progressively worse and worse because you become more tense.

By simply rocking her shoulders and adjusting the placement of her head in between snaps, Taylor keeps her pose from getting stiff and adds a subtle sense of movement to her photos. 

Not only does she look more relaxed, but it also gives the photographers a wider variety of photos to choose from!

Next time you step in front of the camera, try these two tips…

➡️ ONE: After you strike your pose, slowly rock your shoulders in a sprinkler motion.

➡️ TWO: Adjust the placement of your head a little in between each snap.

At 77 I am now alone. A woman wrote that under my list about my mother, and that she has loads of time to do things she never had time to do but no money. She is right, and I left it out. My mother was left on her own at 60 with 1 small check coming in.

3 things she did alone that cost nothing:
📚 The library, twice a week. She read the magazines there and never bought 1.
⚖️ The courthouse, to sit in the back row and watch a trial. She said it beat television.
⛪ Every funeral in the parish, even for people she barely knew. Somebody should come, she said.

None of it fixes having no money. It filled her days, and it kept her around people.

I pay for streaming I barely watch. My grandmother had a library card, and I wrote down 90 of her old ways in a document you can buy, so your evenings stop costing you a subscription.

Harry Styles proved that being a gentleman never goes out of style. 😭

Harry Styles’ appearance at the 2017 Victoria’s Secret Fashion Show is gaining attention again through a viral comparison of male performers interacting with runway models. While the video highlights other artists looking at the models’ bodies, Styles stands out for his polite smiles, eye contact, and respectful demeanor as the women walk past him. His behavior has reminded fans of Taylor Swift’s famous lyric, “In a world of boys, he’s a gentleman,” from her song I Think He Knows. The contrast has sparked renewed appreciation for the singer’s natural charm and gentlemanly presence onstage.

The 2017 Victoria’s Secret Fashion Show took place in Shanghai, China, and featured performances by Styles, Miguel, Leslie Odom Jr., and Jane Zhang. Styles performed songs from his debut solo album, released earlier that year, marking an important chapter in his transition from One Direction member to solo artist.
